title: Minimax Off-Policy Evaluation in POMDPs with Anonymous Complete-State Audits
banked_reason: The headline is delivered and mathematically sound, but the cold referee caps the package at subfield; paper-score ceiling 7.1 is below the 7.4 field gate.
gap_reasons: Its scope is specifically anonymous equality-only audit labels; it does not show that complete-state audits with meaningful coordinates, a known decoder, or controlled representation complexity are equally unhelpful.

For capped cardinality, the note proves only a lower envelope and a sufficient high-cardinality plateau threshold, leaving both a matching intermediate upper bound and necessity of that threshold open, as the framing correctly acknowledges.

The leading-journal score is further constrained by the non-exhaustive priority comparison, reliance on a non-archival internal predecessor as the closest stated substrate, and the absence of a substantive application demonstrating when the anonymous-label regime is empirically relevant.
paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the audit-uniform Hu-Wager rate using fixed-permutation state cloning and later added a sound N=1 capped endpoint and cap-sensitive signed-depth lower envelope. Before the final source clarification, the Lean modules reached a zero-sorry, green-build F3 state; F4 then identified an ambiguity in estimator cardinality access and missing audit-label relabeling invariance. Discovery repaired those source scopes and passed mathematics review, but novelty fell to subfield; the expanded final graph was not rerun through Lean formalization or F4/F5, and the exact intermediate capped risk and necessary plateau threshold remain open.
tldr: Over the cardinality-uniform union of finite-state, single-trajectory Hu--Wager classes---with arbitrary finite action alphabets, full-history POMDP and sequential-randomization laws, known behavior and target policies, stationary behavior initialization, contraction under both policies, one-step policy overlap, and normalized conditional reward moments, but no stationary-distribution-overlap premise---independent anonymous complete-state audits do not improve the cardinality-uniform minimax exponent. Uniformly for \(\eta\in[0,1]\), including full audit, \(R_T(\eta)\asymp T^{-2/(2+t_0\zeta)}\), and observable PHIW attains the upper bound. The audit transfer uses independently refreshed state clones, one fixed unknown permutation per model atom, and an overflow-safe no-collision comparison; audit labels are equality tokens with no metric, coordinates, or known decoder. For a fixed \(\delta_0\in(0,3/8)\), put \(m_{\delta}:=m_\star(T,\eta,\delta_0)\). The capped risk retains the global PHIW upper bound and the singleton parametric endpoint, and it now has the explicit lower interpolation \[R_T(N,\eta)\ge\max\!\left\{\frac{3}{512T},\ c_{\delta_0}\max_{Q\ge1:2(Q+1)m_{\delta}\le N}\min\!\left\{\alpha^{2Q},\frac{L^Q}{T}\right\}\right\},\] with the inner maximum omitted when its feasible set is empty. At \(\eta=0\), \(m_\star(T,0,\delta_0)=1\), so for \(N\ge4\) the feasible choice \(Q=\lfloor N/2\rfloor-1\) gives the corresponding displayed lower term; its \(L^Q/T\) branch applies only until the logarithmic balance. The established \(T^{-\beta}\) plateau above \(N\ge n_Tm_\star(T,\eta,\delta_0)\), the \(N=1\) endpoint, and all existing constants and upper bounds remain unchanged. The exact intermediate minimax dependence and the necessity of the sufficient high-cardinality threshold remain open.
gap: Hu and Wager establish the stationary POMDP minimax exponent when the latent state is never observed. Fully observed MDP theory gives faster pointwise guarantees only after state-indexed nuisance functions are learnable. Neither literature determines whether exogenous complete-state audits change the cardinality-uniform minimax rate under fixed stationary overlap.
fill: The full-filtration factorization gives the PHIW policy-ratio cancellation and the signed-depth observed-path likelihood comparison. A state-cloning and one-time random-relabeling construction preserves those equalities together with value, stationary ratios, policy overlap, and contraction. A no-collision coupling then transfers the hidden signed-depth lower bound to all estimators and all audit frequencies.
